name: crown-blade-bookings
description: Booking integrity for Crown & Blade: verifies every slot lock of a new or rescheduled booking and cleans up expired slot locks.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build-test/test/lockIds.test.js build-test/test/verify.test.js build-test/test/reschedule.test.js build-test/test/cleanup.test.js
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore
